The clean-minus-corrupt gap is now -0.02 nats, so the +0.19 gap on seed 0 (E0002) did not replicate and is treated as noise. Across 320 prompts: 0 correct, logprob of the answer slightly below uniform (-10.78), and seeing the first copy of the sequence gives no measurable benefit. The behaviour is absent.

Stop after step 1. The model does not do induction, so there is no mechanism to localise; running attribution/patching on a clean-vs-corrupt difference of ~0 would only fit noise. No verify_hypothesis run: there is no algorithm to verify. 37 of 40 experiments left unused. Report as a null result.
